# Owned producer result and unchecked throws fixture

An invariant unary Handler<T> binds the same Object-bounded method result formal.
A closed unchecked Exceptions declaration adds no result cast. Four immutable
caller routes run 96 fresh JVM cases twice in source and SDK-provider profiles,
including ignored results, null receivers/handlers, derived dispatch, exact
callback and stage failures, partial writes and late caller casts. All recovered
units compile with original metadata. Six wrong programs and six Code-preserving
controls guard behavior and scope. Only owned fixtures and SDK in-memory readers
execute; no filesystem I/O occurs. Originals use release 8. An optional diagnostic
omits only provider/caller unchecked declarations to isolate the admission gate.
